title: Queue using Stacks
description:
Implement a queue using two stacks. Create a class `QueueViaStacks` with the following methods:
- `push(x)`: Add element to the back
- `pop()`: Remove and return the front element
- `peek()`: Return the front element without removing it
- `empty()`: Return `True` if the queue is empty
hint: Use two stacks: one for pushing, one for popping. Transfer elements from push-stack to pop-stack when the pop-stack is empty.
outputExplanation: Two stacks simulate a FIFO queue. The push stack receives new elements, and the pop stack reverses them to maintain FIFO order.

tests.name: Basic operations
tests.input:
q = QueueViaStacks()
q.push(1)
q.push(2)
q.push(3)
print(q.pop(), q.pop(), q.peek(), q.empty())

tests.name: Push pop interleaved
tests.input:
q = QueueViaStacks()
q.push(10)
print(q.pop())
q.push(20)
print(q.pop())
